name: Sand Hourglass
description: A wooden hourglass that runs once a minute: the sand follows the seconds, a thin stream falls from the neck with grains that tumble off the pile.

steps.script: project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gHg = 'Hourglass'; let n = 0; for (const e of project.elements) { if (['Frame','Sand','Sand stream','Glass'].includes(e.name) || /^(Hop grain|Grain) \d/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gHg'; n++ } } return n
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Main'; return 1
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Aod'; return 1

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gDate = 'Date'; let n = 0; for (const e of project.elements) { if (e.name === 'Weekday' || e.name === 'Day' || e.name === 'Month') { e.group = 'gDate'; n++ } } for (const k of Object.keys(project.groups)) if (project.groups[k] === 'Clock 2') project.groups[k] = 'Clock AOD'; return n
